files.content: import * as React from 'react' import { Warning } from '@phosphor-icons/react' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' import { IconTile } from '@/components/ui/icon-tile' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface AlertBannerCardProps { title: string description: string actionLabel: string onAction?: () => void icon?: React.ReactNode tone?: TileTone } export function AlertBannerCard({ title, description, actionLabel, onAction, icon, tone = 'coral', }: AlertBannerCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] return ( {icon ?? } {title} {description} ) }
